title: Hybrid physical/logical zero-noise extrapolation with limited logical executions
summary: Partially error-corrected logical executions are expected to become available before fully fault-tolerant quantum computation, but such executions usually take much longer runtime than physical, unencoded ones. We formulate zero-noise extrapolation in this regime as a statistical resource-allocation problem in which the physical/logical execution mode is itself an extrapolation design variable.
